_what: Every recording source, in the order offered, as DATA read by parts/record-audio/show/record-in-the-browser.ts. `ask` names the source opener: `record-audio` for microphone, `record-video` for camera and microphone, `screen-recording` for screen or tab audio, and `native-system-audio` for macOS ScreenCaptureKit system output mixed with microphone input. A source whose opener is unavailable is not offered. `device` fills error words; `preview` selects waveform or video; `types` are MediaRecorder formats tried in order; `file_name` names the finished recording. `problems` names errors in plain words. `listed: false` keeps a source out of general pickers while allowing a screen that names it directly. `check_quiet` enables silence feedback, and `silent_problem` can supply source-specific wording. `microphone_change`: a microphone chosen while a recording runs is listened to every `look_every_ms` and takes over the recording the moment its first sound arrives (a phone's or a headset's microphone can open some time before it sends any), the old one going on until then, or after `hand_over_within_ms` even if it stays silent.

sources.label: Record a meeting
sources.permission_problem: Allow Trillion to use the microphone in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then press Record again.
sources.silent_problem: Trillion hears no meeting audio. Check that your microphone is not muted and that the meeting is playing sound.

problems.NotAllowedError: Trillion can't use your {device}. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then press Record again.
problems.NotFoundError: Trillion can't find a {device}. Connect one or turn it on, then press Record again.
problems.OverconstrainedError: Trillion can't find a {device}. Connect one or turn it on, then press Record again.
problems.NotReadableError: Another app is using your {device}, or your computer is blocking it. Close that app, then press Record again.
problems.AbortError: Your {device} stopped before recording began. Press Record again.
problems.NotSupportedError: This browser can't record here. Open Trillion in the latest Chrome, Edge or Safari, then press Record again.
problems.system-audio-permission: Allow Trillion to record screen and system audio in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then press Record again.
problems.system-audio-unavailable: Trillion could not start meeting audio capture. Check Screen & System Audio Recording in System Settings, then try again.
problems.system-audio-in-use: Meeting audio is already being recorded in another Trillion window. Stop that recording before starting another.
problems.system-audio-ended: Meeting audio capture stopped. What was recorded is kept.
problems.unavailable: This browser can't record here. Open Trillion in the latest Chrome, Edge or Safari, then press Record again.
problems.ended: Your {device} stopped, so the recording stopped. What was recorded is kept.
problems.failed: Recording stopped because the browser could not go on. What was recorded is kept.
problems.silent: Trillion hears nothing from your microphone. Check that the one you are speaking into is chosen and is not muted.
problems.code-unreached: Trillion could not load what it needs to record. Check your connection, then press Record again.
problems.code-unavailable: The code needed to record could not load. Reload this page, then press Record again.
problems.page-updated: Trillion updated while this page was open. Reload this page, then press Record again.
problems.preflight-no-room: This device has almost no room left to keep a recording. Free some space, then press Record again.
problems.preflight-little-room: This device is running low on room. A long recording may not fit; free some space if it will be long.
problems.preflight-battery: The battery is very low and not charging. Plug in before a long recording.
problems.default: Trillion could not start recording. Press Record again.
